BELIEF_STATE: UNDERSTANDING: Module responsibility: CLI filter diagnostics for explaining token-saving TOML filters without executing shell commands. Key data flows: - INPUT: FiltersDryRunCmd arguments, sample output from --input file/stdin or hidden --sample, and loaded FilterEngine filters. - PROCESSING: Select a filter by exact name or command match, run the pure dry-run pipeline, then render text or JSON with stage decisions and token metrics. - OUTPUT: Agent-readable dry-run report showing before/after content when requested, filtered output, stage changes, and machine-readable metrics.
